name: Malapert massif
description: PGDA landing-site DEM Site23, Malapert massif. NASA listed Malapert Massif among nine candidate Artemis III landing regions near the lunar south pole (NASA release, 28 October 2024).
citation: Barker, M.K. et al. (2021) Planetary and Space Science 203, 105119. doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
data_note: PGDA states Site23 does not yet have error estimates or clones.

name: Shackleton crater rim
description: PGDA landing-site DEM Site04, on the rim of Shackleton crater at the lunar south pole.
citation: Barker, M.K. et al. (2021) Planetary and Space Science 203, 105119. doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119

name: Connecting ridge
description: PGDA landing-site DEM Site01, "Connecting ridge", one of the LOLA south pole landing-site DEMs.
citation: Barker, M.K. et al. (2021) Planetary and Space Science 203, 105119. doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119

name: Jezero crater (landing area and delta)
description: CTX terrain model of the Mars 2020 landing area in Jezero crater, built for Perseverance's terrain-relative navigation. It covers about 32 km x 30 km.
citation: Fergason, R.L. et al. (2020) Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic. USGS Astrogeology Science Center. doi:10.5066/P906QQT8
